name: Meridian Logistic Group
desc: Meridian Logistic Group transformed its global financial operations by replacing manual, error-prone Excel processes with Prophix. The transition enabled the logistics leader to slash its close cycle by 71% while gaining real-time visibility into cash across 14 countries.
whoText: Meridian Logistic Group is a global leader in third-party logistics, specializing in warehousing, freight, and last-mile delivery. Headquartered in Brussels, the company manages a complex financial landscape across 14 countries with a lean team of 28 finance professionals.

krs.text: Accelerated Reporting:: Reduced the quarterly close process from 21 working days to just six.
Enhanced Accuracy:: Eliminated manual mapping errors and audit risks associated with 47 disparate spreadsheet templates.
Strategic Redeployment:: Shifted two finance team members from manual consolidation tasks to high-value FP&A initiatives.
Improved Liquidity:: Achieved real-time visibility into cash positions across 12 currencies, unlocking significant trapped capital.

data.label: THE CHALLENGE
data.heading: Breaking Free from 'Heroic' Excel Processes
data.body:
Operating across 14 countries with 47 different spreadsheet templates, Meridian’s finance team was trapped in a cycle of manual labor. The quarterly close required 14-hour days for three weeks, leaving the team vulnerable to material mapping errors and audit risks.

Beyond the time burden, the lack of visibility into intercompany transactions and global cash positions meant the finance team was essentially flying blind. The unsustainable workload threatened employee retention and delayed critical reporting to board members and PE sponsors.

data.label: THE SOLUTION
data.heading: Automating Global Consolidation
data.body:
Meridian selected Prophix for its robust Financial Consolidation and Intercompany Management capabilities. By centralizing data from their global logistics hubs, the team replaced fragmented spreadsheets with a single, automated source of truth.

The implementation was completed in just four months, allowing the team to move from a manual, error-prone environment to a streamlined, automated workflow. This shift not only stabilized their audit trail but also provided the treasury team with the real-time insights needed to manage liquidity across 12 currencies.

data.label: THE RESULTS
data.heading: Transformative Efficiency and Insight
data.body:
The impact was immediate: the first close on Prophix was completed in six days, a 71% improvement. Intercompany reconciliations that previously consumed eight days were reduced to a four-hour automated process, freeing up staff to focus on strategic FP&A work.

Beyond time savings, the organization identified €4.2 million in trapped cash within the first month of using the Cash Management module. Today, the board and PE sponsors receive accurate, transparent reporting within the first week of the quarter, marking a new era of financial confidence for the group.

data.title: THE FIRST CLOSE
data.quote: The first close on Prophix felt like cheating. And I mean that in the best possible way.

data.title: THE HUMAN COST
data.quote: You are spending human capital on work that software should be doing, and that cost is invisible until you stop doing it.
